[P2] Approach: cover the settings warning path under rule 4

The added renderer tests render `WriteAccessWarning` directly; none exercises this path through `SettingsModal`. Replacing `testResult?.writeAccess` with `undefined` disables both customer-facing warnings while those tests remain green, and the description explicitly acknowledges the missing modal coverage. This breaks CONTRIBUTING rule 4, “Every branch has a test that fails without it.” Return to the design phase under rule 8, step 6, and agree on observable coverage of the actual settings warning path before revising the implementation.
